name: Editor: clicking a second text input doesn't move keyboard focus off the first
body: Seen in the Silhouette tab (2026-11-18): after typing in one text input, clicking another input leaves the caret and typed text in the first. Clicking a button or a row still works, and the first input clicked after start takes focus normally. Probably in Penumbra or Chaos input focus handling, not the editor. Check a fix there before working around it here; reproduce with the rename and value-key boxes in the Silhouette tab.
